bugs_found: transfer accepts amount without Decimal conversion/validation, so floats or non-Decimal numeric types can cause precision/type issues unlike the other money functions
transfer has no self-transfer guard; same Account can produce a Receipt for a transfer that did not actually move funds
transfer mutates debit before credit; if credit assignment/addition fails due to malicious Account-like object or invalid balance type, balances can become inconsistent
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial behavior without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment schedule without validation
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, so zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates can create invalid converted amounts
apply_fee allows fee_min greater than amount, returning a negative net amount for small transactions
